investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tapari Bank (digital banking); Platform: Google Cloud southamerica-east1 (zones southamerica-east1-a/southamerica-east1-b/southamerica-east1-c); network range 10.103.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster tapari-prod-southa (GKE); Database: accounts-db-01 holds accounts records; Automation: data-retention workflows scheduled by Apache Airflow and executed under service accounts (runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
